# Gresper s. r. o.

> Software company in Bratislava, Slovakia. Web applications, data science and
> custom software — from database and API to the interface.

## What it does

- Web applications: full-stack development, REST APIs, relational databases, deployment.
- Data science and data engineering: collection, cleaning, analysis, reporting, dashboards, models, automation.
- Systems integration: importers, exporters, scheduled sync jobs, connecting systems that were not built to talk to each other.
- Sports timing: a timing system for firesport (požiarny šport) competitions — reads the timing hardware at the track, shows live results at the venue, syncs results online into the app.
